newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Coplex to lease Galaxy rig to Conoco.
newsitem.headline: Coplex to lease Galaxy rig to Conoco.

text.p: Australian-based oil explorer Coplex Resources NL said on Wednesday its 95 percent-owned Galaxy Drilling Ltd planned to lease its Galaxy Driller semi-submersible rig to Conoco Indonesia Inc for at least eight months from September this year.

Coplex said it had executed a letter of intent with Conoco, which is owned by Du Pont Co, with the contract set at standard industry terms of a gross US$67,500 per day along with a mobilisation fee of US$2 million.
The net daily revenue to Galaxy was estimated at US$33,000.
The contract was subject to approval by the Indonesian oil company Pertamina/BPPKA - EKKU WASBANG.
Coplex said the rig would be engaged in Conoco's extensive exploration and development programme in Indonesia's Natuna Sea region.
